title: Full-Court Bring-Up 1v1
description: A ball handler brings the ball up the full court against a pressuring defender, with a ten-second limit to cross half court and a live finish.

content.objective: Beat sustained pressure for the length of the court, within the time limit, and still have the legs to finish.
content.setup: Offense on the baseline with the ball, defender one arm-length in front.
content.organization: Pairs; switch roles after each trip; next pair starts when the court is clear.
instructions: The defender pressures from the baseline.
The ball handler must cross half court within 10 seconds.
After half court, play live 1v1 to a score or a stop.
Defender scores a point for a steal, a 10-second violation or a stop.
Switch roles and come back the other way.
coachingPoints: Attack the defender's chest early to turn them.
Use change of pace more than moves.
Save energy: walk the ball when the defender backs off.
commonMistakes: Over-dribbling side to side without gaining ground.
Arriving exhausted and taking a rushed shot.
content.safety: Legal defense only; stop the play for any dangerous contact near the sideline.
progressions: Defender may trap with a second defender at half court.
variations: Defender must force the ball to one side.
successCriteria: Crosses half court within the limit on most trips.
Scores or gets a good shot on at least half the trips.
content.gameApplication: Every guard faces full-court pressure; bringing the ball up alone builds confidence against it.
